links.outcome: Number of distinct datastore images reconstructed via black-box extraction attack on multimodal RAG
links.effect: A 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images; up to 5.6x as many distinct items as a non-adaptive baseline.
links.quote: A single 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images under local-feature correspondence, and reaches up to $5.6\times$ as many distinct datastore items as a non-adaptive baseline.

screen.reason: Empirical security benchmark evaluating a novel datastore extraction attack on multimodal RAG systems, evaluated on scenarios including a medical radiology assistant, demonstrating privacy risks but not testing a specific safeguard intervention.
